description: A comprehensive privacy evaluation framework synthesized from 1EdTech TrustEd Apps, Common Sense Media Privacy Program, Student Data Privacy Consortium (NDPA), FERPA, COPPA, and SOPIPA. Each criterion maps to exactly one policy characteristic for deterministic, reproducible scoring.

evaluationAreas.name: Data Collection Transparency
evaluationAreas.description: What data is collected, how, and why

criteria.question: Does the policy list all types of data collected with specificity?

evaluation.meets: Policy provides comprehensive, specific list of all data types collected (e.g., 'name, email address, grade level' rather than 'personal information')
evaluation.partial: Policy lists some data types but uses vague categories or says 'may include'
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No specific data types listed, only vague terms like 'user data' or 'information you provide'

criteria.question: Does the policy explain HOW data is collected during app usage?

evaluation.meets: Clear documentation of collection methods (e.g., 'via account registration form', 'automatically through cookies', 'from school via roster sync')
evaluation.partial: Some collection methods mentioned but incomplete
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No explanation of how data is gathered

criteria.question: Does the policy state the specific purposes for data collection?

evaluation.meets: Each data type has a clear, legitimate educational purpose (e.g., 'email for account recovery', 'grades to show progress')
evaluation.partial: General purposes stated but not tied to specific data types
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No purpose stated or overly broad purposes that could enable any use

criteria.question: Does the policy minimize data collection to what is necessary?

evaluation.meets: Only essential data for core functionality is collected; policy explains why each piece is necessary
evaluation.partial: Some non-essential data collected but with opt-out options
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Collects extensive data without clear necessity or educational purpose

criteria.question: Does the policy disclose collection of sensitive data (geolocation, health, biometric)?

evaluation.meets: Explicitly discloses whether sensitive data categories (geolocation, health, biometric, etc.) are or are not collected
evaluation.partial: Some sensitive categories addressed but not all
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No mention of sensitive data categories despite collecting personal information

criteria.question: Does the policy disclose whether behavioral or usage data is collected?

evaluation.meets: Explicitly states whether behavioral, analytics, or usage data is collected and for what purpose
evaluation.partial: Mentions analytics or usage tracking but details are vague
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No mention of behavioral or usage data collection

evaluationAreas.name: Data Ownership & User Rights
evaluationAreas.description: Who owns the data and what rights users have

criteria.question: Does the policy clearly state that users/schools retain ownership of their data?

evaluation.meets: Policy explicitly states users/schools own their data and grants only limited license for service operation
evaluation.partial: Ownership unclear or policy claims broad license rights
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Policy claims ownership or perpetual, irrevocable license to user data

criteria.question: Can users access and export their data?

evaluation.meets: Clear process for users to access and export their data in portable format
evaluation.partial: Access mentioned but process unclear or limited
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No access rights mentioned

criteria.question: Can users delete their data entirely?

evaluation.meets: Users can fully delete all personal data (not just de-identify or anonymize)
evaluation.partial: Deletion available but with significant limitations or only anonymization offered
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No deletion rights or policy retains data indefinitely

criteria.question: Can users correct or amend inaccurate data?

evaluation.meets: Clear process for users to correct or update their information
evaluation.partial: Amendment mentioned but process unclear
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No amendment rights mentioned

criteria.question: Can schools or parents request deletion of student data on behalf of students?

evaluation.meets: Explicit process for schools, parents, or guardians to request deletion of student data
evaluation.partial: Mentions school/parent rights but process unclear
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No provision for school or parent-initiated deletion

evaluationAreas.name: Data Retention & Disposition
evaluationAreas.description: How long data is kept and what happens at contract end

criteria.question: Does the policy specify a data retention period?

evaluation.meets: Clear retention period specified (e.g., '60 days after account closure', 'end of school year + 90 days')
evaluation.partial: Retention period mentioned but vague ('as long as necessary') or lengthy
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No retention period specified or indefinite retention

criteria.question: Is the retention period reasonable for educational purposes?

evaluation.meets: Retention tied to legitimate need (e.g., academic year + reasonable period for records)
evaluation.partial: Retention period longer than needed but not indefinite
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Indefinite retention or retention for commercial purposes beyond educational need

criteria.question: Is data returned or destroyed upon contract termination?

evaluation.meets: Policy commits to returning or destroying all student data upon contract termination within a specified timeframe
evaluation.partial: Mentions data disposition but timeframe or process unclear
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No commitment to data return or destruction upon termination

criteria.question: Does the policy describe specific security measures?

evaluation.meets: Detailed explanation of security protocols (encryption, access controls, security assessments, monitoring)
evaluation.partial: Generic security statements ('we take security seriously') without specifics
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No security measures mentioned

criteria.question: Is data encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+)?

evaluation.meets: Data encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ or equivalent modern protocol
evaluation.partial: Encryption mentioned but protocol version unclear or outdated
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No transit encryption mentioned or uses deprecated protocols

criteria.question: Is data encrypted at rest?

evaluation.meets: Data encrypted at rest using industry-standard encryption
evaluation.partial: Some data encrypted at rest but not comprehensive
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No at-rest encryption mentioned

criteria.question: Are strong password requirements enforced?

evaluation.meets: Strong passwords required (not merely suggested), with specific complexity requirements
evaluation.partial: Password requirements mentioned but weak or optional
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No password requirements or very weak standards

criteria.question: Is two-factor authentication, SSO, or managed accounts available?

evaluation.meets: 2FA, SSO, LTI, or school/district-managed accounts supported
evaluation.partial: Available as optional feature but not default or well-promoted
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No enhanced authentication options

criteria.question: Are employees with data access bound by confidentiality agreements?

evaluation.meets: Employees with access to student data are bound by confidentiality agreements and data protection obligations
evaluation.partial: General mention of employee training but no specific confidentiality requirements
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No mention of employee data access controls or confidentiality

evaluationAreas.name: Third-Party Data Sharing
evaluationAreas.description: How data is shared with external parties and subprocessors

criteria.question: Does the policy list all third parties that receive data?

evaluation.meets: Individual listing of each third party with functionality justification (e.g., 'Amazon AWS for hosting', 'Google Analytics for usage metrics')
evaluation.partial: Some third parties listed but vague categories ('service providers', 'partners')
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No third parties listed or only says 'we may share with partners'

criteria.question: Does the policy specify what data is shared with each third party?

evaluation.meets: Specific data types shared with each third party separately documented
evaluation.partial: General categories of shared data but not tied to specific third parties
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No detail on what data is shared

criteria.question: Can users opt out of non-essential third-party data sharing?

evaluation.meets: Simple, accessible opt-out process for non-essential third-party sharing
evaluation.partial: Opt-out available but difficult or only for some third parties
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No opt-out option for third-party sharing

criteria.question: Are third parties contractually bound to maintain equivalent privacy protections?

evaluation.meets: Policy states vendor accountability for third-party privacy compliance through contracts
evaluation.partial: Some mention of third-party obligations but not explicit contractual requirements
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No assurance of third-party privacy protection

criteria.question: Will users be notified of changes to third-party relationships?

evaluation.meets: Commitment to notify users when third-party relationships change
evaluation.partial: Policy update notification may cover this but not explicit
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No commitment to notify about third-party changes

criteria.question: Are subprocessors disclosed and contractually bound to the same data protection obligations?

evaluation.meets: Subprocessors identified, contractually bound to same protections, and schools notified before changes
evaluation.partial: Subprocessors mentioned but governance details unclear
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No mention of subprocessors or their data obligations

evaluationAreas.name: Data Monetization & Commercial Use
evaluationAreas.description: Whether and how data is used for commercial purposes

criteria.question: Does the policy prohibit selling user data?

evaluation.meets: Explicit statement: 'We do not sell user data' or 'We never sell student information'
evaluation.partial: Ambiguous language or loopholes (e.g., 'we don't sell for money but may share for value')
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Policy allows data sales or does not address selling

criteria.question: Does the policy prohibit targeted or behavioral advertising?

evaluation.meets: No targeted advertising; no ads at all is optimal; explicitly prohibits behavioral ads
evaluation.partial: Contextual ads only or ads with unclear targeting
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Interest-based or behavioral advertising using user data

criteria.question: Does the policy prohibit third-party tracking for advertising?

evaluation.meets: Third parties explicitly prohibited from tracking users for ad purposes; no web beacons for ads
evaluation.partial: Some third-party tracking limitations but not comprehensive
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Third-party ad tracking allowed

criteria.question: Does the policy prohibit cross-site or cross-app tracking?

evaluation.meets: No tracking across apps or websites; no cross-context profiling
evaluation.partial: Limited cross-context tracking for specific purposes
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Cross-app/site tracking allowed

criteria.question: Does the policy prohibit commercial profiling of students?

evaluation.meets: No creation of user profiles for commercial purposes; no data enhancement for advertising
evaluation.partial: Profiling for 'service improvement' with unclear boundaries
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Commercial profiling allowed

criteria.question: Are tracking technologies (cookies, beacons, pixels) fully documented?

evaluation.meets: Complete cookie/tracker list with each technology's specific functionality documented
evaluation.partial: General cookie information but not comprehensive listing
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No tracking technology disclosure

evaluationAreas.name: Child & Student Protection
evaluationAreas.description: Special protections for children and students

criteria.question: Does the policy address age restrictions?

evaluation.meets: Clear age requirements stated (e.g., '13+' or 'all ages with school consent') with enforcement mechanism
evaluation.partial: Age mentioned but unclear enforcement
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No age requirements or restrictions mentioned

criteria.question: Does the service obtain verifiable parental consent or operate under school official exception?

evaluation.meets: Either verifiable parental consent process OR operates under school official exception with proper documentation
evaluation.partial: Mentions COPPA compliance but mechanism unclear
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Allows under-13 without proper consent or exception

criteria.question: Are there special protections for children's data?

evaluation.meets: Enhanced protections for children (stricter retention, no ads, no selling, limited sharing, parental review rights)
evaluation.partial: Some child-specific protections but not comprehensive
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Children treated identically to adults without special protections

criteria.question: Does the policy disclose its intended audience (K-12, under 13, teachers)?

evaluation.meets: Explicitly states whether intended for children under 13, K-12 students, teens 13-18, teachers, or general audience
evaluation.partial: Some audience information but incomplete
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No indication of intended audience or age group

criteria.question: Does the policy prohibit re-identification of de-identified student data?

evaluation.meets: Explicitly prohibits attempts to re-identify de-identified or anonymized student data
evaluation.partial: Mentions de-identification but no re-identification prohibition
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No mention of re-identification restrictions

evaluationAreas.name: Breach Response
evaluationAreas.description: How data breaches are handled and communicated

criteria.question: Does the policy describe breach notification procedures?

evaluation.meets: Clear commitment to notify affected users and schools of breaches with defined process
evaluation.partial: Breach notification mentioned but vague on process
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No breach notification policy

criteria.question: Does the policy commit to a specific breach notification timeframe?

evaluation.meets: Commits to notifying schools/users within a specific timeframe (e.g., 72 hours) of confirmed breach
evaluation.partial: Mentions timely notification but no specific timeframe
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No breach notification timeframe commitment

evaluationAreas.name: Transparency & Communication
evaluationAreas.description: How clearly policies are written and communicated

criteria.question: Is the privacy policy written in plain language?

evaluation.meets: Policy understandable by non-technical audience (teachers, parents); avoids excessive legalese
evaluation.partial: Mostly clear but some sections overly technical
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Dense legal language throughout; inaccessible to average reader

criteria.question: Does the policy provide contact information for privacy questions?

evaluation.meets: Specific privacy contact provided (email, form, or dedicated privacy officer)
evaluation.partial: General contact info but not privacy-specific
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No contact information provided

criteria.question: Will users be notified of material policy changes?

evaluation.meets: Active notification (email, dashboard alert) before material changes take effect
evaluation.partial: Passive notification (updated date on policy page) or notification after changes
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No commitment to notify users of changes

criteria.question: Are policy changes available for review before taking effect?

evaluation.meets: Changes published for review before effective date; users can review and opt out before new terms apply
evaluation.partial: Changes posted but take effect immediately or with minimal notice
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No advance review of policy changes; continued use constitutes acceptance

criteria.question: Is there an education-specific version of the policy or terms?

evaluation.meets: Separate education/school privacy policy or terms with enhanced protections
evaluation.partial: Education context mentioned within general consumer policy
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Only consumer-focused policy; no education provisions

criteria.question: Does the policy reference FERPA compliance or school official role?

evaluation.meets: Explicit FERPA compliance commitment and operates as school official or under school official exception
evaluation.partial: FERPA mentioned but obligations or role unclear
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No FERPA reference (significant gap for K-12)

criteria.question: Is student data used only for educational purposes?

evaluation.meets: Data used solely to provide educational service; no repurposing for marketing or product development unrelated to education
evaluation.partial: Primary use educational but some secondary uses allowed
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Student data used for non-educational commercial purposes

criteria.question: Is the product designed and marketed for K-12 school purposes?

evaluation.meets: Product explicitly designed for K-12 use with education-specific features and marketing
evaluation.partial: General product with some education features or marketing
evaluation.doesNotMeet: Consumer product without K-12 specific design or marketing

evaluationAreas.name: Data Transfer & Governance
evaluationAreas.description: Data handling during business changes and governance rights

criteria.question: Does the policy address data handling in merger, acquisition, or bankruptcy?

evaluation.meets: Clearly states data protections survive business changes; users notified and can delete data before transfer
evaluation.partial: Mentions data transfer in business changes but protections unclear
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No mention of data handling during business changes or allows unrestricted transfer

criteria.question: Do schools have the right to audit the vendor's data handling practices?

evaluation.meets: Schools explicitly granted right to audit or inspect vendor's data handling and security practices
evaluation.partial: General compliance certifications offered but no direct audit rights
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No audit or inspection rights for schools

criteria.question: Does the policy prohibit data mining student data for commercial compensation?

evaluation.meets: Explicitly prohibits data mining of student data as a form of compensation or commercial gain
evaluation.partial: General prohibition on commercial use but data mining not specifically addressed
evaluation.doesNotMeet: No restriction on data mining student data for commercial purposes
